name: restruct/silverstripe-seo
description: SEO essentials for Silverstripe CMS 6: meta title, description fallback, robots (meta + X-Robots-Tag), canonical (tag + Link header), Open Graph with fallbacks, a sitemap bridge, and structured data (JSON-LD).

suggest.wilr/silverstripe-googlesitemaps: sitemap.xml; pages set to noindex are left out of it automatically
suggest.dnadesign/silverstripe-elemental: content blocks; the page checks read the rendered page, blocks included
suggest.symbiote/silverstripe-queuedjobs: checks the whole site in the background (SeoSiteCheckJob) for the site report; without it, run sake tasks:seo-check-site
suggest.restruct/silverstripe-ai: optional AI suggestions in a later version
